title: Igris harness distribution manifest
description: Per-project declaration of agent prompt harnesses to mechanically regenerate from canonical sources. Core owns this schema; each project ships its own data manifest. See FR-136.

_schema.description: free-form human field-doc block; ignored by tooling

version.description: Manifest format version. Bump only on a breaking schema change; FR-136 ships v1.

surfaces.description: FR-137: non-agent projection surfaces. 'skills' is fleshed out here (core-owned in surfaces-manifest.json, or personal via the FR-139 overlay). 'os_context' remains RESERVED for FR-140 (permissive). An absent or skills-only surfaces block validates. Additive flesh-out — no version bump (still v1). TD-191: `skills` is now an ARRAY of blocks (multi-source) — loaders normalize legacy single-object overlays to `[object]` on read so back-compat holds without a version bump. FR-161: `mcp_servers` is added as a 4th surface (ARRAY of blocks, mirroring `skills`); v1 is GLOBAL-ONLY (consumers treat every block as global even though the schema reuses $defs/scope for forward-compat). Additive — still v1, no version bump.

mcp_servers.description: FR-161: MCP-server projection blocks (FR-160 epic). An ARRAY of blocks, one per MCP server, mirroring `skills`. Each block declares the canonical command/args/env once; the compile pass (FR-164) merges it into each target harness's config. v1 GLOBAL-ONLY: `scope` is accepted for forward-compat but consumers treat every block as global. Core-owned blocks land in surfaces-manifest.json; personal blocks via the FR-139 overlay. NOTHING consumes this in FR-161 — schema/validators only.

os_context.description: RESERVED for FR-140 (rules+prompts OS-context projection). Permissive until FR-140 fleshes it out; an absent block is the normal case in FR-137.

scope.description: FR-155: scope-aware overlay. Absent → global (default, back-compat). `{type:'global'}` is also accepted; the compiler/drift treat both as 'emit unconditionally'. `{type:'project', paths:[...]}` emits ONLY when --project-root realpath ∈ realpath'd paths[]. CLI realpath's `--project` at WRITE time so paths[] entries are canonical; compile/drift realpath both PROJECT_ROOT and each entry at READ time (handles macOS /tmp ↔ /private/tmp).

skills_surface.description: FR-137/TD-191/FR-149/FR-151/FR-153/FR-155/FR-157/FR-171: ONE skills projection block. Multiple coexist as elements of `surfaces.skills[]`; each carries its OWN source/layer/targets so personal blocks compile ALONGSIDE the core block. For personal blocks `source` points at a registry-vendored path (L-516 universal copy-vendor). Valid (type, method) pairs: claude/symlink, codex/symlink, gemini/symlink, agents/symlink (registry-anchored per-skill symlinks), opencode/command (FR-171 thin command wrappers). The four symlink targets vendor identically — the per-harness compiler walks the registry-vendored skill tree. The `agents` target projects into the cross-CLI shared `~/.agents/skills/` standard that codex+gemini both read natively (FR-157). FR-171: `opencode/command` writes a thin `<command-dir>/<name>.md` wrapper whose body loads the canonical SKILL.md via OpenCode's `@file` directive (single source of truth stays the canonical SKILL.md). The legacy codex/compiler (AGENTS.md aggregator) + gemini/converter (per-skill TOML) pairs were retired by FR-153. `scope` (FR-155) is optional; absent → global. See L-519.

source.description: Skills root dir holding {skill}/SKILL.md entries. A leading '~' or an absolute path is used verbatim; otherwise resolved vs --project-root. Default ~/.igris/core/skills.

layer.description: FR-139 provenance seam: 'core' (declared in surfaces-manifest.json) or 'personal' (contributed by the FR-139 overlay).

path.description: symlink (claude/codex/gemini/agents): output dir under which each <skill>/ becomes a symlink to its registry-vendored canonical (FR-149/FR-151/FR-153). command (opencode, FR-171): the OpenCode command dir under which each <name>.md thin wrapper is written. The legacy compiler/converter methods were retired by FR-153.

mcp_surface.description: FR-161 (FR-160 epic): ONE MCP-server projection block. Multiple coexist as elements of `surfaces.mcp_servers[]`. `canonical` declares the command/args/env ONCE (env values are ${VAR} references, never inline secrets); the FR-164 compile pass merges this into each target harness config (config-MERGE, not symlink). `targets` carries a SEPARATE enum from agents/skills — MCP adds a 4th harness (`opencode`) and its `method` is always the const `merge`. v1 is GLOBAL-ONLY: `scope` is accepted (reuses $defs/scope for forward-compat) but consumers treat every block as global. `startup_timeout_sec` is a Codex-only passthrough. See FR-160 plan §FR-160a.

layer.description: FR-139 provenance seam: 'core' (declared in surfaces-manifest.json) or 'personal' (contributed by the FR-139 overlay).

env.description: values are ${VAR} references, NOT inline secrets (enforced at write-time by the FR-162 verb)

layer.description: RESERVED / forward-compat for FR-139 (Layer-2 customization registry). Provenance only - the compiler enforces the Core/Personal boundary physically via separate base + overlay manifest files (see FR-136 plan section 2), NOT via this field. Defaults to 'core' when absent. FR-139 may write 'personal' (or a namespaced value) on overlay entries.

dir.description: canonical prompt dir, resolved relative to --project-root

body_exception.description: optional; basename of a body-exceptions/<name>.json sidecar

path.description: output harness path. Resolved per 3-case shape (FR-154): leading `~/` expands against $HOME, `/abs/...` is verbatim, otherwise relative to --project-root. FR-171: `opencode` agent targets project a registry-anchored symlink (OpenCode's agent loader follows symlinks) to harness.opencode.md.
